publication.body:
Records the operator’s twelve individually accepted architecture decisions as ADR0076–0087, preserving the original proposals, approval/revision history and all69 task mappings. Adds reciprocal refinement links without promoting unrelated Proposed records.

ADR0084 replaces the unaccepted CLI-only proposal: Beta1 requires both server-hosted website reviews and website-controlled reviews run by an installed local agent, plus CLI support. Access is invitation-only with GitHub sign-in; Agent Logic provides server-mode model access. The website and private code repositories remain separate, with the code repository name undecided. Planning contracts now require both website journeys. Missing implementation owners and downstream typed-card/dependency updates remain explicit prerequisites to #914/#915 execution; documentation does not prove delivery.

Validation:12 decisions,69 mappings,44 pinned sources and14 negative fixtures; preserved historical suite with21 sources and10 negatives. Independent exact-head review and native proof/review precede publication. No product/provider/cloud execution, deployment or release readiness claimed. Local-mode model-access funding remains an open product choice.

Closes #945
